name: Bahamas Rum Cake Factory
brand_truth: One recipe, one downtown Nassau shop since 2000, now the Official Rum Cake of The Bahamas.

design.signature: Their Original bundt on a conch disc with rotating ring text; six pack planner; hover-preview flavour menu

current_site_findings: Older listings, including the hotel association directory, still point to bacardirumcake.com, which could not be opened.
Shop address, hours and phone are hard to find on your own site; Yelp and the directories disagree.
The founding story and the 2014 'Official Rum Cake' recognition sit on an inner page.
The homepage is a long, repeated product grid on mobile.
Several product images are named after stock photos.
pitch_line: Cruise visitors decide on the walk from the port; this concept tells them in one screen that you are the Official Rum Cake of The Bahamas, where the shop is, and lets them plan a six pack before they arrive.
assumptions: Street shown as East Bay Street (Yelp); record says McPherson St
Phone (242) 328-3750 and opening times (7:30 Mon-Sat, 8:00 Sun) from Yelp
'Coming soon' delivery hook is the agency platform placeholder, inactive
notes: Listed site bacardirumcake.com is outdated; the business runs a modern Shopify store at thebahamasrumcakefactory.com, so the pitch is brand and story, not e-commerce. Reviews and star ratings on their store deliberately not reproduced. Product images hotlinked from their Shopify CDN; AdobeStock-named files avoided. Banana and Key lime have no own photo, shown typographically.
